_help: Copy to config.json (the launcher does it and fills the keys). Relative paths start at the repository root.
_keys_help: require_api_key false = any program on the allowed addresses may ask media, without a key.
_mysql_help: Only for backend = mysql: same tables as a pack. media_storage: hash = file named <hash> in media_root, path = media.path under media_root, auto = both.
